newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-Nov state firm exports down 14 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-Nov state firm exports down 14 pct yr/yr.

text.p: China's state-owned enterprises exported $75.3 billion worth of goods in January-November, down 14 percent from the same period a year ago, the China Daily said on Saturday.
Exports by foreign-funded companies had shot up 32 percent in the 11 months, the newspaper said. It did not give a value figure for exports of foreign firms.
The state sector accounted for 57 percent of China's total exports, it said but gave no further details.
Exports in January-November were $132.78 billion, up 0.9 percent compared with the same period a year ago, according to the latest official figures.
Exports in November alone were $13.62 billion, a rise of 11.8 percent from the month before, the figures show.
